recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞多，有許多核摺疊、胞質淡灰藍的單核球與前單核球，並夾雜少數原始細胞、有核紅血球與分葉中性球，未見原始細胞成片；呈骨髓單核球系增生，符合 JMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with mixed myelomonocytic cells
Large monocytes and promonocytes with folded nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Occasional blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, not in sheets
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Segmented neutrophils and granulocytic precursors present
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a mixed population of monocytes and promonocytes showing folded nuclei and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, together with occasional blasts, granulocytic precursors, segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors. Blasts do not form sheets. Findings are consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia; correlation with peripheral monocytosis, splenomegaly, HbF level, absence of BCR-ABL1 and RAS-pathway mutation analysis is required.

ddx.vs: AMML shows >=20% blasts plus promonocytes forming a dominant population rather than a maturing myelomonocytic background.
CML marrow is granulocyte-predominant with basophilia and is BCR-ABL1 positive.
Pediatric MDS shows cytopenias with multilineage dysplasia and lacks the monocytosis and proliferative features of JMML.
